name: Fillable Documents – let visitors fill Word and Excel forms on your page
author: sumoffice

sections.description:
Put a working document on your page, not just a picture of one. Your visitors type into a Word letter, change the numbers in an Excel calculator and watch the formulas recalculate, or put their own text into a PowerPoint presentation, then print the result or download it as .docx / .xlsx / .pptx. No sign-in, no app to install.

Pick a document from the free Layers catalog in the block editor, or paste a one-line shortcode. The frame grows with the document, so nobody scrolls inside a small box.

What your visitors can do

  • Fill in a letter or form right on your page: names, dates, amounts, the details of their case.
  • Use a live Excel calculator. They change the input cells and the totals update as they type.
  • Edit a presentation. A pitch deck, a lesson or a report: they change the slides and download .pptx or a PDF.
  • Print it or download it as a Word, Excel or PowerPoint file they can send, sign or keep.
  • Do it on a phone. The light “web page” view is made for small screens.
  • Keep their copy private. Each visitor gets their own copy in their browser session; other visitors never see it. Saving a copy to a free Layers account is optional.

Who it’s for

  • Teachers and schools — letters to parents, class records, study schedules, school forms, lesson plans and lesson presentations your students and parents can fill in.
  • HR and small businesses — offer and resignation letters, payment reminders, invoices with tax calculation, 13th-month pay and budget calculators.
  • Lawyers and notaries — affidavits, a special power of attorney, demand letters, complaints and applications, contracts of lease; a notarial register in Excel.
  • Non-profits and community groups — monthly and annual budgets, fee records and receipts, event and gift budget planners.
  • Personal finance bloggers — savings, deposit and budget calculators readers can try with their own numbers.

Free features

Documents

  • 4,300+ documents, calculators and presentations in the free Layers catalog. Word letters, affidavits and forms; Excel budgets, invoices, savings plans and school records; PowerPoint pitch decks, lesson and report presentations.
  • 28 catalog languages, among them English, Spanish, French, Arabic, Italian, Portuguese, German, Japanese, Turkish, Korean, Polish, Indonesian and Vietnamese.
  • Two views: a light web page (best on phones) or the full Word / Excel / PowerPoint editor.

Embedding

  • “Layers document” block with a search box: type “invoice” or “budget”, click a result, see the live preview in the editor.
  • Shortcode for the classic editor, widgets and page builders: [layers-doc slug="affidavit-of-loss"].
  • Automatic height: the frame follows the length of the document. The small script that does it ships inside the plugin.
  • Lazy loading: the frame waits until the visitor scrolls near it, so the rest of your page loads first.
  • Settings page: catalog language in the block picker, default height, default view, automatic height, and an optional Layers affiliate code.

Privacy

  • No advertising or analytics cookies in the frame, so the embed adds nothing to your cookie banner for tracking.
  • No sign-in and no personal data asked from your visitors to fill in, print or download. Visitor contact details are not sent to the website owner.
  • No credit link by default. A “Powered by Layers” link appears only if you turn it on.
  • Clean uninstall: removing the plugin deletes its settings and cached catalog.

Optional 30% affiliate share

If you have a Layers affiliate code, enter it in Settings → Fillable Documents. The plugin adds that eight-character code to the document frame as ref. If one of those visitors later becomes a paying Layers customer, the affiliate receives 30% of that payment under the Layers affiliate program. This does not give the affiliate the visitor’s name, email, document or other contact details.

Browse the catalog and copy slugs at layers.md/embed.

Shortcode

[layers-doc slug="affidavit-of-loss" view="page" height="760"]
  • slug (required) — the template, as in app.layers.md/t/<slug>.
  • view — page (light web page, best on phones) or file (the Word / Excel / PowerPoint editor). Default: the plugin setting.
  • height — starting height in pixels (300–4000).
  • title — accessible title of the frame.

Settings

Settings → Fillable Documents: catalog language in the block picker, default height and view, automatic height, an optional Layers affiliate code, and an optional “Powered by Layers” credit link (off unless you turn it on).

External services

This plugin embeds documents served by Layers (https://layers.md), an online office suite.

  • What is loaded and when: every page with a Layers block or shortcode shows a frame from https://app.layers.md/t/<slug>. The visitor’s browser loads the document from Layers when the frame comes into view. When a visitor edits, prints or downloads the document, the browser exchanges the document with Layers.
  • What is sent: the template slug, a mark naming your site (from=embed-<your-domain>), the optional eight-character affiliate code (ref), and the standard request data of any web page (IP address, browser user agent, referring page). Layers counts opens and edits per site mark and attributes paid subscriptions to the affiliate code; it places no advertising or analytics cookies in the frame. Visitor contact details are not sent to the website owner.
  • In the editor: when an editor opens the block picker, your site (not the visitor’s browser) fetches the public template list from https://app.layers.md/v1/public/templates and caches it for 12 hours.

Layers terms of use: https://layers.md/userAgreement — privacy policy: https://layers.md/privacyPolicy
sections.installation:
1. Install from Plugins → Add New, or upload the zip and activate.
  2. Add the “Layers document” block to a page, search the catalog and pick a document. Or paste a shortcode.
  3. Optional: open Settings → Fillable Documents to set defaults or add your Layers affiliate code.
sections.faq:
Is it free?

Yes. Embedding catalog documents is free.

Do my visitors need an account?

No. Visitors fill in, print and download without signing in. They can save a copy to their own Layers account if they want to keep editing later.

Does it work on phones?

Yes. Choose the “Web page” view (the default) for letters and forms: it is a light page made for small screens. Excel calculators also open on phones in the spreadsheet editor; visitors tap a cell, type a number and see the totals update.

Can I use it with Elementor or another page builder?

Yes. Any builder that runs shortcodes works: add its Shortcode widget or block and paste [layers-doc slug="your-template"]. In the block editor, use the “Layers document” block.

Which languages are in the catalog?

28 languages, from English, Spanish, French and Arabic to Japanese, Korean and Vietnamese. In Settings → Fillable Documents you can limit the block picker to one language. The documents keep their own language; the plugin’s own screens are in English and can be translated.

Can I embed my own .docx, .xlsx or .pptx?

Not through this plugin: it embeds documents from the public Layers catalog. To embed your own file, upload it to your Layers account, publish it and use the embed code Layers gives you.

Does it work with Excel macros (VBA)?

Catalog calculators use ordinary formulas and recalculate in the browser. Macro support depends on the document; check it on layers.md first.

Can I change a catalog document before embedding it?

The block embeds the catalog version as it is. Your visitors’ changes stay in their own copy and do not change the page for anyone else.

Does the frame need a cookie banner?

The frame sets only the cookies the document needs to work (no advertising, no analytics). Check your local rules for your own site.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • New display name focused on the visitor action: fillable Word and Excel forms.
  • Optional Layers affiliate code passes as ref; affiliates receive 30% of attributed payments without receiving visitor contact details.
  • Removed the unreleased document-inquiry relay until that delivery path is ready.

1.2.0

  • Optional consent-based “Send to this company” button for filled documents.
  • New setting for the destination email; the address is never added to the iframe URL.

1.1.0

  • PowerPoint presentations from the catalog: pitch decks, lesson and report presentations.
  • Block picker language filter: 28 catalog languages instead of 7.
  • Catalog now holds 4,300+ documents, calculators and presentations.

1.0.0

  • First release: block, shortcode, settings, automatic height.
